title: Canonical affine open sections restriction transformation
statement: Under the hypotheses of new-local-stalk-sections-canonical-colimit, there exists the natural transformation ν₀ with the displayed adjunction-unit and pullback-lift component formula.

proof.text: Construct the component maps by the adjunction unit followed by restriction along the pullback lifts; naturality follows from functoriality and unit naturality.

mathlib_searches.query: sheaf sections affine inverse system colimit

mathlib_searches.results: No exact theorem for supplied adjunction and etale sites.

lean.statement: theorem affineOpenSections_exists_canonical_transformation {X : Scheme.{u + 1}} {J : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory J] [IsCofiltered J] (D : J ⥤ X.Etale) [∀ j, IsAffine (D.obj j).left] [∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (D.obj j).hom] (c : Cone (D ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X ⋙ Over.forget X)) (p : c.pt ⟶ X) (hp : ∀ j, c.π.app j ≫ (D.obj j).hom = p) (hc : IsLimit c) (H : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hH : H ⊣ p.Etale.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X.smallEtaleTopology c.pt.smallEtaleTopology) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) : ∃ ν₀ : D.op ⋙ F.obj ⟶ (Functor.const Jᵒᵖ).obj ((H.obj F).obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt)))), (∀ j, ν₀.app (op j) = (hH.unit.app F).hom.app (op (D.obj j)) ≫ (H.obj F).obj.map (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (B := p.Etale.obj (D.obj j)) (pullback.lift (c.π.app j) (𝟙 c.pt) (by change c.π.app j ≫ (D.obj j).hom = 𝟙 c.pt ≫ p rw [Category.id_comp] exact hp j)) (by exact pullback.lift_snd _ _ _)).op)
